# Roadmap resume: all three stages are complete

**What I reconciled**

- **Stages 1 and 2** were reconciled at the 2026-10-09 resume. Stage 3's `Consumes` already cites plan 3's Handoff, with its `(Resolved at resume, 2026-10-09)` mark.
- **Stage 3** is stamped COMPLETE (2026-11-04) by plan 5. That plan's `## Handoff to later stages` reads `None`, so it amends nothing.
- **No stage is unticked.** This roadmap came from a spec, not New-Project Entry, so there is no Ranked list waiting.

The roadmap file needs no changes and there is nothing to commit. No next stage exists to hand off.

**Next: the roadmap-completion review**

Before the roadmap can retire, I re-run the gap rubric over R1–R6 against the system as it stands now. Each requirement counts as met only with a `path:line` or a test name that names the plan that built it. A stage stamp alone is not evidence. These checks only read files:

```
Read  specs/parking-occupancy-spec.md                      # exact R1–R6 text, §2–§4
Read  specs/plans/completed/2-sensor-ingest.md             # Deviation notes, R1–R3
Read  specs/plans/completed/3-occupancy-rates.md           # Deviation notes, R4
Read  specs/plans/completed/5-occupancy-dashboard.md       # Deviation notes, R5–R6
Read  specs/deferred_items.md                              # if present
Grep  -n "interval|minutes|15|300|5 \* 60" sensors/        # R3: the 15-min poll at sensors/poll.py:18 at entry; Stage 1 exit requires 5 min
Grep  -rn "bay_events|occupancy|0.95|95" --include=*.py .  # R1, R2, R4–R6 implementation sites
Grep  -rn "def test_" tests/                               # test names for duplicate-event, hand-count, all-9-car-parks, 95% alert
```

R3 is the row I'll check most closely. It was implemented-differently at entry, with polling every 15 minutes against the spec's 5. I'll confirm the shipped code actually polls every 5 minutes, or that plan 2 records a `> Deviation:` note explaining why not.

When the audit is done, I'll bring you the full R1–R6 table. Any unmet requirement then needs one of two decisions from you:

- a new stage, which keeps the roadmap live, or
- a conscious deferral with a written reason.

If every requirement is met, the roadmap moves to `specs/completed/` beside the retired spec.
